description: Hosley Set of 6, 2.5 Ounce Tangerine Splash Wax Cubes Each Hand Poured Wax Infused with Essential Oils. Create a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere in your home with Hosley's wax cubes/melts. As soon as they start melting, they instantly release a pleasant, soothing fragrance! As the fragrance is dispersed throughout your home it will freshen the air and help assist in removing lingering odors, without the use of an open flame. Once hardened, these wax cubes are recyclable and reusable. They don't produce any wick or soot making an easy clean-up with just a paper towel. They are easy to use, just break off a cube and add to your wax warmer and enjoy! Use one cube at a time to fill your space with fragrance (use more than one as needed depending on the size of the space). Our wax melts spread a relaxing fragrance and a welcoming atmosphere throughout your home. Not only are these wax cubes safe to use in your home or office, but they also provide a great benefit with a no-flame feature (Wax Warmer Sold Separately). Hosley wax melts are a perfect source for everyday use. Wrap them up as a gift or use them as a stocking stuffer. Spread these fragrances around and share with your family and friends.
